title: Public Programming
description: Examines the central role of public programming and interpretation in museums, galleries, heritage programs/sites and related agencies, and the relationship with learning and education. Emphasizes approaches which respond to community interests and audience learning priorities. Planning, delivery, management and evaluation strategies for a range of programming approaches are covered.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of AHVS 488G, HA 488G.
Subject to differential fees; consult Fees for Undergraduate Programs.
